tei:div.tei:p: 247) rdor sems zhi khro sbags sgrub kyi zin bris rig 'dzin rol pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 248)

༄༅/ na mo gu ru badz+ra dhā ra ye// mtshan gyi snang byed yid la reg ma thag /nang gi mun pa rmang nas gzhil ba dang*// chabs gcig ye shes snang ba rgyas mdzad pa/ khyab bdag bla ma snying gi thig ler bzhugs// rgyud lung man ngag rgya mtsho yi/ snying po'i yang zhun bsil zer can// rdor sems zhi khro sbrags ma yi// tshom bu tshogs sgrub lag len bri// de la snga 'gyur bka' ma rgyal po dzaḥlas brgyud pa gzhir bzhag dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa dang*/ sher gter smin pa 'bras bu lta bu zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gter kha zung 'brel gyi tshom bu tshogs sgrub bgyi ba la/ gza' skar dus tshes bzang po la sa chog sta gon sogs bya ba'i thog mar rtsa gsum gcig shes kun grol las gsungs pa bzhin yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas nas lcogs stegs lta bur bdag skyed bla gtor g.yas g.yon du sman raka chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar/ sa dkyil la dkar zlum mtheb ril can gnyis/ gser skyems/ mtha' skor byang shar mtshams 'dzin me tog shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs sil/ lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas bcas bskor bsham bya/ thog dung gi brda dang sbrags te gzan sham/ mnab chos/ dbu zhwa bcas phebs/ mdun du dril 249) gdan steng nang mchod/ rdor dril dang*/ slob dpon mdun/ ḍā ma ru/ nas bzed/ yungs bzed/ las bum/ g.yab dar dmar nag gdab phur bcas 'khod/ tshul phyag dang gral phyag bcas 'khod nas/ byang 'dren pas/ hūm̐: o rgyan= sogs/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs lan gsum gdangs ma/ rang rang bla rgyud gsol 'debs ci rigs ma dang*/ rdor sems rgyud 'debs/ las rdor pas dung zhal dri chus bkang ba las bum khar badz+ra ma hā= sogs bsang chu bsgrub/ gdangs lhug spel mas bdag skyed bzlas pa bsdu rim/ stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur/

oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ slar yang rdo rje sems dpa'i skur= kun la khyab/ ces pa'i bar brjod/ ma hā kro dhi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs te cha gsum gtang*/ bdag skyed mchod pa bsdu/ sa lha'i gtor ma gnyis la chu bran nas/ sgrub khog gi mchod rlabs la zhi rol/ dung chen rgya gling bcas thams cad la yod/ gtor gzhong= sogs nas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ la dril bcas bsdu rgya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho la rang rgya/ badz+ra bha wa la rnam nang 'dren/ dril bsil/ dril pad/ pri thi sogs la pad skor dang rang rgya se gol gtogs/ shab+da la zhi rol/ a ka ro= pad skor dang gtor rgya se gol/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas= yo ga bzhi dril bya ba sgrub khog gi tshig bcad phal mo che spyi 'gro yin/ 250) thim par gyur/ zhi rol 'og las rdor pras zhwa phrag gzed gtor ma g.yas/ gser skyems g.yon gyis btegs te phyir 'bul/ bhū mi= sogs la dril bcas bsdu rgya/ s+thā na la pad skor nam mdzod se gol/ dgongs shig= rta 'don/ gats+tsha la se gol/ gshegs par gyur/ zhi rol 'og gtor ma gser skyems phul/ mchod pa bskor bshams bsdu/ slob dpon mnab chos bcas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun nas bzhengs te/ dbang phur seng ldeng lta bu smad zla gam du bzhogs pa zhig bzung ste/ bdag nyid= sogs nas/ pad+man+tā krita= lan bdun pas dkyil 'khor dbus su gdab/ phur bu las= sogs/ swa bhā ba= lan gsum la slob dpon gyis rdo rje bcas dkyil 'khor gyi sa la bsnun/ gzhan rnams kyis kyang snun tshul bya/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las= rnam dag ye shes kyi zhing khams chen por gyur/ gzhi bgegs gtor ma bsham/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum la mkha' lding rgya/ sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dril bcas lcags kyu'i rgya/ sarba bhigh+naṃ= la pad skor nam mdzod se gol bcas/ hūm̐: rnal 'byor chen po'i= sogs nas/ brlag par gyur: zhi rol 'og bgegs gtor phyir dor/

hūm̐ bi shwa= zhi rol 'og las rdor gyis gu gul bdug yungs bzed thogs pas sna drangs slob dpon gyi g.yas bskor gyis bgegs bskrad/ zhi 251) khro'i/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka= lta bus srung 'khor bsgom/ slob dpon byang shar nas dkyil 'khor dbus su zhal mdun bstan gyis bzhengs/ rdor dril tshur zhu/ las phur phyag tu phul zhing*/ bdag gi thugs ka nas= sogs/ gha gha gha ta ya= lan gsum la phyogs bcur bsgril zhing byang shar du gdab/ slob dpon gral du 'khod/ bsam lhun mgo blangs nas sngags rgyun pas bsam lhun tshar gsum/ sher snying tshar gsum/ bar chad lam sel/ sgrol ma/ rnam 'dzoms/ dme brtsegs/ lo gyon/ phur snyen/ tshe snyen/ rnams tshur ma 'khor bar 'don/ las rdor gcig gis las bum/ nas bzed/ gcig gis ang gdan du rgyal chen bzhi la dkar zlum/ sgo byang gnyis la dmar gtor/ chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar bshams pa thogs/ 'dus pa rnams zhwa chos bcas/ dge bskos spos bam thogs pas sna drang*/ rkang gling pa gnyis/ rgya gling pa/ dung chen pa/ gzhung gral/ g.yas g.yon gyi rnga pa rnams dang*/ slob dpon gyi rdor dril dang dbu mdzad gnyis kyis rol mos sbub chal thogs nas/ shar tho'i mdun 'khod/ zhwa bzhes/ badz+ra a mṛ ta= ram̐ ya ྃkham̐/ thams cad stong nyid= lhug 'don/ shab+da la dung chen/ rgya gling bcas/ thing gcig zil/ bzhag rol/ gtor gzhong= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ mkha' lding rgya bcas tho bzhi ka la 'gro/ bdag nyid= sogs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya/ 252) thing gsum/ zil/ (Musical notes and signs here) gsang bdag spyan sngar= tho gdangs/ (Musical notes and signs here) brtan par bzhugs/ sngags zil/ bzhag rol/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ sngags lan bdun/ shab+da la/ thing gcig sil/ bzhag sngags mthar gtor sngags lan gsum/ hūm̐/ dri za'i= lhug 'don/ kun srung shig: sil/ bzhag rol/ sngags/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra= zhwa phrag dgal/ lho'i tho rtsar zhwa bzhes/ thams cad stong nyid=

gtor gtong= bdag nyid= sogs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thang gcig sil/ sum gcig hūm̐/ gsang bdag= lhug hūm̐/ gshin rje'i= gdangs ma/ nub tho'i/ gsang bdag= gdangs ma/ klu yi= lhug byang tho'i/ gsang bdag= lhug gnod sbyin= gdangs/ rdo rje gcal du mnan dong brus par ling ga mnan chas byas pa'am shog ling rkyang pa yin na dong du gding*/ zhwa bzhes/ slob dpon gyis gser skyems thogs te/ bka' brgyad/ byin rlabs mchog rtsol= gdangs chen nam/ ma bcos spros bral= rnga dang 'cham stabs bstun dgos pas las rdor gyis phud skong*/ 'bru bzed/ phud snod bcas thogs la phud phor 'cham pa la 'bru dang phud/ tshig mtshams re re bzhin du blug rkang gling bcas/ thing gsum zil/ (Musical notes and signs here) rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= sh+lau kal re re'i mtshams su 'cham/ lhu gsum rdzogs nas/ sil/ bzhag rol/ slob dpon la g.yab dar nag po phul/ ling ga la 253) rak+ta bran/ oṃ yaṃ raṃ= sogs nas 'gugs pa la khyad par du sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs= zhes kha bsgyur/ mchis par gyur cig (Musical notes and signs here) g.yab dar gsum/ lcags kyu sogs rgya bca'/ rkang*/ bshums pa bzhi 'bud/ lan gsum pa'i mthar tho gdangs kyis/ hūm̐/ dam sri bya ba'i= sogs/ slob dpon la skyer phur sor bzhi pa phul/ da ni khro bo'i phur tshogs gdab/ ces pa'i skabs phur pa mnan dong du bskyur/ yungs dkar/ rdo dkar phye ma/ dug khrag sogs skam rlon thun rdzas slob dpon la phul/ thun tshogs gdab ste zhes pa'i skabs su thun brab/ rgyud tshogs gtibs zhes pa'i skabs su las rdor gyis gu gul bdug ri rab brjid pa'i= zhes pa'i skabs su dur rdo la ri gling dang rgya gram bris pas mnan/ (Musical notes and signs here) 'og tu mnan/ zil 'bebs ring po'i 'og las rdor gcig gis sa spar re dang chu thig re blug las rdor gcig gis me cung zad dang rlung g.yab kyis rlung lan re g.yab pa dang sbrags slob dpon gyis rdo rje rgya gram re mdzad/

de 'dra ba lan bcu tsam rjes sats+tsha nag po zhig gis mnan te gdangs rol gong bzhin gyis/ hūm̐: gcig ni= sogs/ (Musical notes and signs here) mtha' ru mnan: zil/ bzhag rol/ rnga rol rnams mnan pa'i khar spungs/ slob dpon rang mal shar du 'khod pas/ oṃ suṃ bha ni= sogs kyis mdzub 254) mo lu gu rgyud du sbrel ba'i bro ra zlum por bskor la las bzhi'i bro bka' brgyad las byung ba ltar ram zhi khro'i/ phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i shar phyogs= la bka' brgyad rta bro'i dbyangs bcas mthar/ sum bha ni= oṃ shin+taṃ ku ru swa hā sa rgya dgrol/ g.yas bskor gyis slob dpon lhor 'khod/ gung mo sbrel ba'i bro ra gru bzhir bskor/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang*/ lho phyogs kyi bro/ hūm̐ bzhi/ bh+rum̐ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swa hā sa rgya dgrol/ slob dpon nub tu 'khod/ srin lag sbrel ba'i bro ra zla gam/ hūm̐ bzhi/ nub phyogs bro/ hūm̐ bzhi/ hrī wa shaṃ ku ru swa hā sa rgya dgrol/ slob dpon byang*/ mthe'u chung sbrel/ gru gsum bskor/ hūm̐ bzhi/ byang phyogs bro/ hūm̐ bzhi/ hūm̐ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ kyis rgya dgrol/ zhwa phrag bkal gyis ging pa gnyis nas me thun chu thun brab/ phyi sgor ra sog la gshin rje'i sku skyer phur bcas dmar gtor mchod pa gtang*/ 'dus pa sgau rgyab nas zhal nang bstan gyis/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las a las= sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/ ma hā kro dhi sa bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las las kyi= sogs nas/ sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ rnams rang rgya/ sngags bdun/ shab+da la thing gcig zil/ bzhag gtor sngags gsum/ gdangs rol rgyal tho ltar/ thub par mdzod/ zil bzhag sngags lan gsum/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ nang sgor ra sog la 'khyil pa'i sku 255) skyer phur bcas btags/ 'dus pa nang sgo nas zhal phyir phyogs te bzhengs nas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las bhañdza'i= sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/

las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa= sogs nas/ shab+da la thing gcig zil/ bzhag khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa= gdangs sam lhug mthar zil bzhag rol/ sngags lan gsum/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sgo them nang du skyer phur gyi dbal la ār+ya a tsa la'i sngags dang shog dril btags pa brub khung zan ling can la btab ste/ sgo 'di yan chad= sogs brjod/ zhwa phud nang la rang gral du 'khod/ tshe snyen mtha' bsdu/ chab ril dgram/ snang grags rigs gsum= gyis tshogs grol/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhar ma traṃ mgo lho nub tu bstan la gzhag shar ngos su slob dpon sngags chas bcas zhal nub tu phyogs te g.yab nag dril bcas bzhugs/ rgyal tshab pas zhwa chos bcas ma traṃ gtong thun gsung*/ zhwa bzhes byang 'dren pas bskul te/ badz+ra ma hā shṝ he ru konyahaṃ/ bdag nyid las kyi= ma traṃ ka ru tra dzaḥ 'gugs rgya bcas lan bdun/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum= sogs/ kha sgyur dam sri mnan pa'i skabs ltar la/ log 'dren thams cad= sogs nas 'gugs rol/ 256) (Musical notes and signs here) bka' brgyad bka' bsgo'i 'bebs gdangs kyis/ hūm̐/ dam sri bya ba'i= (Musical notes and signs here) tho bas gzhom/ zil nang sngags gtang*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor steng zhabs g.yas pas ma traṃ mnan/ hūm̐/ ma tra= ཾsogs 'bebs gdangs/ tshul du mnan/ (Musical notes and signs here) zil/ oṃ ma hā= sngags lan bdun/ slob dpon gyis rtse gsum rgya ma traṃ snying gar bsnun/ 'dus pa thams cad kyis snun tshul bya/ gzugs phung hrul gyis= sogs/ med par gyur/ zhes pa'i rjes su rtsa gral ( skad len gral ?) gnyis zhwa phrag bkal gyis dkyil 'khor mthar bro ra bskor/ zhwa bzhes nas dam sri mnan pa'i skabs ltar las bzhi'i bro brdung*/ de'i tshe las rdor gyis ma traṃ gyi lhu tshigs phral nas/ mgo lho nub/ snying dbus/ lag g.yon nub byang*/

rkang g.yon byang*/ gsang gnas byang shar/ rkang g.yas shar/ lag g.yon shar lho/ glo ba lhor dgaud/ bro tshar nas zhwa phud cing gral du 'khod/ zhwa bzhes nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar du gnas pas/ bh+rum̐ dzñā na= sogs nas/ khog pa ye shes rol pa'i= thams cad kyis khu tshur bsnol rgya/ hūm̐ pra be= lan bdun gyi tha ma la dgrol/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo= slob dpon gyi lag gnyis dkur brten/ rkang g.yas kyis mchong*/ rkang g.yon btegs pa'irdo rje'i 'gros kyis/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha ha/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ kyis g.yas skor lan gcig 257) de 'dra ba lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi= sogs kyi dus byang shar nas dbus su zhugs la zhal shar du phyogs pas bzhugs/ khro bcu'i phur pa ka to rar bzhag pa dang phur gdan bcu/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar/ lho/ nub/ byang*/ shar lho/ lho nub/ nub byang*/ byang shar/ shar gyi rgyab tu gcig nub gyi rgyab tu gcig bcas 'khod/ rang gi thugs ka nas= thams cad kyis dril bcas hūm̐ mdzad rgyas/ sum bha ni= slob dpon gyi rdor dril zhu/ tho ba dang steng gi phur pa phul te/ hūm̐/ steng 'og= sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ki li= sogs kyi dus/ rkang g.yon 'gom tsam dang*/ rkang g.yas kyis bskor ba/ rkang g.yon gyis lcags mda'/ yang rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yas kyi lcags mda'/ de 'dra gsum gyi mthar/ rkang g.yon gyi rting pa btsugs te phur pa tho bas bsnun/ shar gyi rgyab tu steng gi phur pa gdab/ 'cham stabs de lta bus shar phur shar du gdab/ sngags badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ḥ gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de nas rkang g.yas kyis 'gom tsam dang*/ g.yon gyi bskor ba tsam las stabs 'dras shar lho'i phur pa shar lhor gdab/ de gnyis spel mas/ lho nub/ nub/ nub byang*/ byang*/ byang shar*/ rnams su gdab/ slar rkang g.yas 'gom tsam gyis g.yon gyis bskor nas 'og gi phur pa/

nub rgyab kyi phur gdan la gdab/ bgegs rnams kyi= sogs kyi dus rdor dril phul/ srung 'khor 'don tshig rdor sems la med 258) pas zhi khro'i/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka= lta bu gdaun/ ma traṃ dang phur pa rnams phyogs ma 'khrul bar bsdu/ las rdor nas zhwa phrag bkal gyis/ dung phor du ba byung dri bzang sman sgrub btab pa thogs/ hūm̐: bla med= sogs zhi rol nang slob dpon gyis phyag gnyis kas chag chag gdab g.yas skor du phebs nas/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor nub tu bzhengs shing las rdor shar du 'khod pas/ 'dus pas zhwa phud/ lho nub rnga yab= sogs gsol 'debs le'u bdun ci rigs thig tshon byin rlabs ma tshar bar du gsung*/ slob dpon gyis rdor sems cho ga'i/

hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rikā/ rang nyid rdor sems su gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyi thig skud de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ye shes lnga dang dbyer med par gyur/ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pas las rdor la thig sna gtad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ swa āṃ hāḥ cung zad bzlas nas slob dpon gyis yar bsgril/ las rdor pas mar bsgril/ de khar rgyang nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i se gol gyen bstan du gdab cing*/ oṃ āḥ sogs gong gi sngags lan re gsung*/ gnyis kas g.yas bskor gyis slob dpon lhor bzhengs/ las rdor pas rgyab 'gros bcas byang du sleb nas sngags se gol lan gcig g.yas bskor gyis slob dpon shar lho/ las rdor nub byang*/ sngags se gol lan gcig g.yas 'gros kyis slob dpon lho nub/ las rdor byang shar/ 259) sngags se gol/ g.yas bskor kyis slob dpon shar lho/ las rdor gyis rgyab 'gros bcas byang shar/ sngags se gol/ slob dpon nub byang*/ las rdor rgyab 'gros bcas lho nub/ sngags dang se gol/ slob dpon rang mal/ las rdor rgyab 'gros bcas byang shar/ sngags dang se gol/ slob dpon shar lho/ las rdor rgyab 'gros bcas lho nub/ sngags dang se gol/ slob dpon nub/ las rdor shar du gnas pas thig bsdu/ tshon phor dbus dkar por hūm̐/ shar mthing gar oṃ/ lho ser por swa/ nub dmar po āṃ/ byang ljang gur hā rnams bris pa dgod/ tshon rnams rigs lnga yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyi rin po che'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ hūm̐ oṃ swa āṃ hāḥ tshar nyer gcig brjod/ tshogs mang gis/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dkyil 'khor dbus su slob dpon gyis dri bzang ba byung sbrags mas thig le gru bzhi gcig bya/ las rdor pas mar gyi tshom bu gru bzhi 'bras kyis g.yogs pa gcig bkod nas slob dpon gral du 'khod/

las rdor pas mchod pa skor bsham dang*/ mdun ngos su bla gtor/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka sbreng thur dang bcas pa gzhag rdor sems gyi/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'og min= shab+da= zhi rol/ sman raka gtor ma'i sngags lan gsum re/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ 'dir spros pas lcogs na/ shu n+ya ta= 'khor 'das chos= 260) sogs nas spyan 'dren mchod bstod kyi/ mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pa'i bar gtang*/ bsdu na 'og gi sgrub pa'i gzhir= sogs/ chen por dpal rdo rje sems pa'i lha tshogs= gsal bar gyur/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra satwa ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swa hā/ sogs/ shab+da= zhi ro/ mi rtog rdo rje= rigs lnga'i spyi phyag spos ring me sbar ba 'gyed/ thams cad kyis zhwa bzhes dkyil 'khor la phyogs par pus mo g.yas btsugs g.yon bslangs rdor dril bcas/ hoḥ dus gsum bla ma= lan gsum/ spos bsdu/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu bsdu/ lha rnams bar= sogs brjod/ bum pa la gu gul bdug slob dpon gyis yungs thun brab/ las rdor gyis chu gtsang gis bshal/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bi shwa badz+ra= zhi rol rkang du can/ bum pa'i rdzas sngags zhi khro'i bum sgrub dbu'i sngags sam/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ dal 'don nyer gcig tsam brjod/ dkyil 'khor dbus mañdza'i khar zhal mdun bstan du gzhag mchod pa gsar du bsham pa'am kha gso/ rdor sems kyi mchod pa byin rlabs tshar gcig zhi rol bcas/ ma hā kro dhi= swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las= dbus su dpal rdo rje sems pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi= gsal bar gyur/ gu ru badz+ra satwa a r+ghaṃ= shab+da zhi rol/ mi rtog rdo rje= bstod/ rang gi thugs ka= sogs/ las rdor gyis dkyil 'khor la nas gtor pad skor bcas bum pa 261) las gzungs thag blangs te slob dpon la phul/ slob dpon gyis kyang de ltar blangs nas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ stong tsam/ yig brgya brgya rtsa tsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha rnams 'od du zhugs=

sogs/ gyur/ las bum khar dung zhal 'khaud/ rdor sems gyi/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du= ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal la= sogs/ skur gyur/ sngags brgya dang brgyad/ khro mo dbyings phyug= ma hā kro dhi sa g.yas g.yon dbus gsum 'thor g.yab kyis bran/ mchod pa sogs bsdu/ e ma ho/ mtsho dbus ge sar= sogs/ chab 'grem/ bzang spyod/ gang du skyes pa'i= chos tshul= rgyal ba kun gyi= sogs dang*/ de ltar 'grub pa byed pa'ang dkon mchog gsum= gyur cig snang grags rig gsum= tshogs grol/ 'dus pa byings nas sna sel du sats+tsha brgya tsam gdab/ tshe thar dang srog bslu/ rnam 'joms dme brtsegs kyi gzungs brgya stong ci'i grub res khrus bya/ na rag skong bshags dang yig brgya stong*/ sems skyed sdom chog blang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ yum bka' lta bu zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rtsa gsum tshogs dang bskang gso grangs mang*/ sgrub khang gi shar du sher phyin/ lhor stobs po che/ nub tu lang gshegs/ byang du tog gzungs dang grwa lnga/ chu gtor/ brgya bzhi/ lus sbyin bsang zhi ba rnams bya'o// las rdor la sogs pas thig 262) gdab dgos pas/ dang po shar nub tshangs thig gdab// dbus dang phyogs bzhir mtshan ma bya// shar nub tshad nas gnyis pa dang*// phyogs bzhir tshad nas zur thigabatsal// tshangs pa'i thig gi phyogs bzhi ru// cha chen dgu dgu bco brgyad gdab// gcig drug phyed gdab phyi ma gdab// gnyis bdun brgyad rnams cha bzhir bsgo// gsum pa bzhi pa mi gdab gzhag /lnga dgu dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab// rta babs phyi mtha'i rim pa ni// rta rkang ka rgyan mtha' dang mnyam// chu skyes dang ni sgrom bu gnyis// de las cha phran gcig gis ring*// zar tshags de las gnyis kyis thung*// sna 'phyang de las gcig gis ring*// chun 'phyang de las gnyis kyis thung*// shar bu de las gcig gis ring*// de las khyung mgo gcig 'phyar ro// pad+ma 'khor lo'i gdugs gsum po'i// rgya tshad cha phran gnyis re ste// pad+ma'i chas g.yon cha phran phyed/

de bar ri dwags re re bri// glang rgyab mig gsum skor tshul ni// snam bu gsum pa'i phyi thig dang*// tshangs thig 'dzoms pa nas bzung ste// cha phran gnyis kyi dbus ma bskor// mun pa pa ti'i phyi thig dang*// tshangs thig 'dzoms pa'i g.yas g.yon du// cha phran gnyis re phyin pa nas// cha phran gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon bskor// de rnams phyi ru cha re bskor// sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa skor tshul// snam bu 263) gsum pa'i phyi thig dang*// tshangs phyir gnyis phyin 'dzoms pa nas// bzung ste ka rgyan rtse nas bskor// de nas 'phred gnyis phyi ru gcig /phyin te snga ma'i tshad des bskor// de rnams phyi rol cha phran gnyis// cha phran gcig dang cha chen gyis// bskor ba pad rdor me ri'i sa'o// ༈ tshon thob ni/ rdor sems yab yum mngon rtogs ltar/ 'dab brgyad mdzes tshon/ sgo phyogs mdog rtsig pa dkar mthing ser dmar ljang ba'i lnga sbrags/ 'dod rnams dmar/ pha gu ser/ drwa gzhi nag la drwa ba dkar/ shar bu gzhi sngo zar tshags dkar/ mda' yab dkar/ mun pa glang rgyab nag rta bab dang po bzhi sngo/ rdo rje ser po 'greng pa/ chu skyes dmar po/ sgro ma mdzes tshon/ zar tshags dkar/ gzhi nag sna 'phyang ser/ sgril 'phyong gzhi nag drwa ba dkar/ shar bu dkar gzhi sngo/ khyung mgo mthing*/ pad+ma dmar/ 'khor lo ri dwags ser/ gdugs dkar/ sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog phyi khams ljang gu pa tra ris/ ge sar ser/ pad 'dab so gnyis sna tshogs/ rdo ra gzhi nag rdo rje ser/ me ri sna tshogs/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams rnams su zla phyed rdo rje re re/ rta bab dang mda' yab kyi 'khor yug la rgyal mtshan dang ba dan 'dogs pa dang*/ sgo'i phyi rol du tā la'i ljon pa/ dpag bsam kyi shing*/ rin po che phung po/ khrus kyi rdzing rnams phyogs rair gnyis gnyis/ phyi'i grwa bzhir lho nub tu me long*/ nub byang du pi wāṃ/ byang shar du dung zhal chus bkang ba/

264) shar lhor zhal zas rnams mdzes tshon gyis bri/ thig tshon gyi bya ba rdzogs nas/ badz+ra muḥ sa ye shes pa gshegs/ 'di yan chad nub dang po'i bya ba'o// nyin gnyis par gung tshigs rgyab tu brda bcas tshogs nas kha seng ltar bdag bskyed bzlas pa yig drug stong*/ yig brgya brgya tsam bzla/ slob dpon dril spos 'dzin/ rgyal tshab/ rgyal thebs/ las rdor kun nas rdor sems sku gzugs/ zhi khro'i tsaka li/ rdor sems dang zhi khro gnyis kyi gzhung pod/ med na gter mdzod dum pa/ sngags byang*/ rdo rje dril bu/ rnam rgyal bum pa/ gsang thod/ sin+dhu ra'i me long*/ shel rdo/ sgrub pa'i gtor chen/ zhi gtor ril bu zhe gnyis can bzhi/ drag gtor mtheb skyu nge brgyad can drug chos skyong pho rgyud/ mo rgyud/ gter bdag gzhi bdag chad tho/ brtan ma/ sman raka tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ mda' dar/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi gtor ma/ dkyil 'khor chas rnams thogs la 'khod/ byang 'dren pas/ oṃ: dpal ldan rdo rje= zhi rol rjes thams cad kyis/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ kyas zhwa bzhes nas ldang dzapra dbyangs lan gsum rjes zhi rol rgyud gsum mam dal myur spel ma'i tshe g.yas bskor lan gsum gyis mdun du 'khod nas/ hūm̐/ bla med gsang ba= yo ga bzhi dril/ mthar rol ring 'og g.yas bskor gyis dkyil 'khor rgyab phyogs su rtsa gtor/ mdun phyogs su skong gtor bcu/ g.yas su pho rgyud/ g.yon du mo rgyud/ 265) de gsum ka'i g.yas su gter bdag chad tho/ g.yon du gzhi bdag brtan ma/ g.yas su sman/ g.yon du rak+ta/ ldeng khri gong mar sku gsung thugs rten/ dkyil 'khor dbus su dbang bzhi'i chas sogs dgod/ rdo rwa'i steng khro bcu'i phur pa/ 'og tu ma traṃ lhu tshigs rnams phyogs ma nor bar dgaud/ chu gnyis nyer spyod bskor bsham/ mdun ngos su zhi mchod rang gi g.yon phyogs nas mchod mgo bzung ba dang*/ drag mchod g.yas ngos nas mchod mgo bzung ste me tog steng dbang lnga'i me tog

zhal zas bzhag sar sha rus zhal zas kyang dgaud/ phyi mchod brgya rtsa 'dzoms na mtha' skor du bsham/ nyin re bzhin du 'bul rgyu'i chos skyong gtor spungs/ chad brtan/ dkar bgegs/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams kyang 'tshogs par bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang du lcags hom du nyul le'i shog ling*/ las phur stegs bcas yungs dkar/ rdo phye rnams kyang nyer bsdog bya/ byang 'dren pas gzhi bshams ma tshar bar bsam lhun sogs bskul/ bshams zin nas dpon slob thams cad bzhugs gral du 'khod/ bla med mchog gi= nam mdzod lan gsum/ zhi rol 'og rgyal tshab chos gos bcas rtsa gral mjug nas dbu zhwa bzhes te/ mnga' gsol stong thun gsung/ mar me'i smon lam gdangs ring ngam mnga' gsol rta thung gis gsungs/ thams cad kyis rjes zlos/ bstan pa'i sgron 266) me zhes pa'i skabs su slob dpon la thod chang mar ril can drang*/ rgyal tshab ston pa'i= skabs gtong thun gsung mkhan dang rgyal thebs bla ma rnams la drang*/ kun bzang yum= las rdor che ba la drang*/ rdo rje karma= dbu mdzad rnams/ rdo rje ging mchog= ging pa gnyis/ rdo rje mtshams pa bgegs bskrad byon ma'i bla ma/ rdo rje spyan pa= dge bskos/ rdo rje dus mtshams las rdor rnams/ rdo rje phyag tshang= gnyer pa/ rdo rje byan por= ja ma phyag bde rnams/ gser phreng= mched mang la/ rdul phyag skyes bu= sgo srung chu len sogs/ zhi rol gtong thun bcas rgyal tshab rgyal thebs rnams slob dpon mdun bzhengs te dbyangs bor len/ don dam spros bral= tshig bstun/ thod skam dbu rgyan/ glang ko mi lpags/ sbrul chun/ stag sham/ zhag gi zo ris/ rak+ta'i thig le/ thal chen tshom bu/ thod phreng tshar gsum/ rdo rje'i go khrab/ dpal 'bar me sgron bcas las rdor gyis rgyal tshab la phul/ rgyal tshab kyis slob dpon la phul/ slob dpon gyis rgyal tshab rgyal thebs rnams la dbang bskur mthar/ zhi rol ring po'i 'og rgyal tshab rgyal thebs rnams kyis 'dus pa la brim nas rang gral du bzhugs/

thams cad kyis khu tshur dpung mgor bsnol te/ hūm̐: snang srid= yo ga shā ya phaṭaḥ la rgya dgrol/ thal mo sbyar te/ hūm̐: khams sum= pra tīts+tsha hoḥ bar gtang*/ dbang ma thob pa sogs yod na bsre bsnan dgos kyang dbang ma thob pas sgrub gral bsdad par 267) don dben pas btang snyoms su gzhag 'og gi rdor dril byin rlabs thams cad kyi lag g.yas kyis rdo rje gsor/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra= dril bu g.yon pas dkrol dkur brten/ badz+ra gheṇ+ḍa= rdor dril thugs kar bsnol/ sarba ta thā ga ta= gzhan thams cad kyis rdor dril sar gzhag slob dpon rkyang pas dkrol dgos pa gong gsal thams cad du dbu mdzad kyis sbub chal nam rdung la 'dra/ dung chen 'dor gtang*/ dbu mdzad pas thing rkang len dus rnga dpon drug gis rnga len nas/ zur gsum sprad/ lhod gsum phab nas/ (Musical notes and signs here) dus/ skad len pas rol mo 'khrol skabs rnga g.yog drug gi rnga bslangs te brdung*/ thing rkang*/ gsum/ zil 'bebs/ (Musical notes and signs here) nas je mang btang ba'i thing gsum*/ sil 'bebs nang rkang gsum 'bud/ rnga ma ru 'ur/ bzhag rol dus rol len pas rol mo thang la bzhag pa dang rnga g.yog drug gis gzhag rol dpon gyis bzhag pa dang rnga dpon drug gis 'jog dgos pa rnga chog rigs thams cad la 'dra ba yin/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i= zhwa bzhes te bzhengs/ hūm̐: spros med= yo ga bzhi dril/ sngags mthar zhi rol/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi= sogs lhug 'don/ sid+dhi hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma= slob dpon dril bsil/ g.yab dar dmar po/ las rdor gyis sna tshogs g.yab dar/ thing dang po la gcig zil/ 268) mthar rai re/ rkang dung gis sna drangs dung chen 'dor gtang*/ rgya gling bcas thing*/ gsum/ rkang*/ bzhi/ zil 'bebs/ sum rdung mtshams yod med dal mos/ sngon bskal ma'i dbyangs kyis / dus gsum bde shegs= tshig rkang gnyis/ gzugs sku= man 'bebs gdangs bcas rnga shad can gyis gtang*/

gsung gi nga ro la bshugs pa/ gnyis/ dus la bab: (Musical notes and signs here) zil bzhag rol/ zhwa phud nas 'dzapra dbyangs lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyi phog pa'i= sogs/ ngang du gyur/ dal gcig mnyam par gzhag oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ dge ba 'di yis= rdo rje sems dpa'= chab 'gyed/ bzang spyod sogs smon lam man kha seng ltar/ snang grags rig gsum= gyis grol lo/ ༈ dngos gzhi'i nyin rnams su/ dge bskos nas ja zhus la lan gdab/ nangs mor lam dus dbang chog sogs rgyun khyer rnams btang nas/ dge bskos nas spos bskor/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs gdangs ma lan re/ kun bzang rdor sems= bstan pa'i bdag po= rab 'byams rgyal ba= mnyam med gtsug gi= 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= lang gro lo tsā= gdod nas rnam dag= bslab gsum rnam dag= shud pu dpal seng= mkha' khyab zhing nas= shes bya kun mkhyen= 269) 'phags pa= phyi ltar rgyal ba'i= 'jam dpal byin rlabs= bka' gter lung zin= chos brgyad mdud pa= smra ba'i seng ge'i= dus gsum rgyal ba= yon tan sangs rgyas=

bka' brgyad brgyud 'debs gdangs kyis/ rnam dag chos dbyings khyab= yongs rdzogs sam tshigs bcad gsum drug gang rung*/ de rnams thams cad sku gsum thob par shog dus slob dpon gyi dril bsil dung chen 'dor gtang*/ thang che 'bring chung gsum/ zil 'bebs/ (Musical notes and signs here) de 'dra cha bcu gnyis/ mthar thing gsum/ zil bzhag rol/ de bka' brgyad brgya rdung chen mo yin/ nyin dang po las rdung srol med/ nyin gnyis pa la/ thing gsum/ zil/ (Musical notes and signs here) de 'dra lan gsum rjes/ thang gsum/ zil/ bzhag nyin gsum pa lta bu bsdus pa la/ thing gsum/ zil/ rkang gsum/ ḍā bzhag rol/ nyin bzhi pa la bka' brgyad brgya rdung 'bring po rgyan bkod skabs de gtang*/ de rnams spel ma bya/ rdor sems kyi bsang chu sogs dung chu las bum khar gzhag badz+ra ma hā shṝ= sogs nas rtse gcig rgya/ sngags lan brgyad/ khro mo= sngags lan gcig la/ slob dpon gyis g.yas g.yon dbus gsum gtor rjes/ las rdor gyis dung chu 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor mdun dkar bgegs gnyis la 270) bran dus sngags lan gcig raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ las rdor gyis dung chu las bum du blugs/ slar dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams 'dzin me tog khar 'khod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum la mkha' lding rgya / s+tha na pa ti= pad skor nam mdzod/ lan gsum/ se gol/ yo ga spyi gdangs kyis dril 'dzin/ gang dag 'dir gnas= zhi rol la dkar/ dung*/ zhwa phrag bkal gyis dkar gtor phyir phul/ sarba bigh+naṃ= pad skor/ nam mdzod/ se gol bcas lan gsum/ hūm̐: rnal 'byor chen po'i= yo ga dril 'dzin/ bdun rgyud rigs kyang= zhi rol dung chen/ dkar/ dung ṇir gtang*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa= zhi rol/ dkar dung*/ dril bsil/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ bsdu rgya/ dbang gi 'jam gdangs sam bka' brgyad rang gdangs kyis/

rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas= lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ bsdu rgya/ slob dpon dril bsil/ dung chen 'dor thing*/ gsum/ zil/ sum rdung mtshams yod med nas bka' brgyad bka' bsgo'i 'bebs gdangs kyis/ hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: gzhan du dengs: (Musical notes and signs here) zil nang*/ rkang*/ bzhi/ bka' brgyad me mtshams kyis/ hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi= (Musical notes and signs here) zil/ bzhag rol/ mchod rlabs yo ga'am lhug 271) sman raka gtor gsum sngags lan gsum re/ badz+ra puṣ+pe= sogs rang rgya/ shab+da= mthar dung chen/ thing*/ gsum/ zil/ sum rdung mtshams yod med ni/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: rtog bral= nas lhug 'don/ rang bzhin med par gsal: bka' brgyad spyan 'dren 'bebs gdangs kyis/ hūm̐: dpe med= nas/ (Musical notes and signs here) sku gsung thugs yon= sogs nas/ gshegs su gsol: zil/ su rdung mtshams yod med nas/ hūm̐: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan= shar 'don/ phyag 'tshal lo: (Musical notes and signs here) rnga mi 'jog dma' mtho spel ma'am/ 'dod yon lnga gdangs res mos kyis/ hūm̐:bla ma kun bzang= bzhes su gsol: zhi rol/ dung chen/ ḍā ru/ thang gcig (Musical notes and signs here) sum rdung mtshams yod med nas/ drag dmar mchod gdangs kyis/ hūm̐: bla ma= sogs tshig rkang re len res kyi ma rdzogs bar res mos kyis/ hūm̐: bla ma= sogs tshig rkang gnyis re len res kyis ma rdzogs bar gsang 'dus nang mchod kyi/ hūm̐/ snang ba yab la= len res/ (Musical notes and signs here) zil/ bzhag rol/ rnga rol gzhag bka' brgyad sman mchod kyi/ hūm̐: rigs lnga= thams cad kyi lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas nang mchod gzung*/ g.yon dril bcas thal mo bkan nas/ sarba pañtsa= la thig gtor/ brgyud mchod sdig sgrib rnam sbyong nang ltar ram/ gter gzhung rgyud 'debs zhal bsgyur na/

rnam dag 272)chos dbyings= skye med= rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas= thugs rjes= sarba= gsal dag= ma 'gags= skyon med= nges med= yang dag= phyogs med= bla ma kun bzang rgyal ba= dpag med nam mkha'= ka ya sid+dhi oṃ/ spyi bor thig le/ wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ mgrin par/ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ snying khar/ nang mchod rdor dril bsil/ hūm̐: rigs lnga= nas shar 'don/ (Musical notes and signs here) kha raṃ khā hiḥ sum gcig zil/ ḍā/ rkang bzhi/ sum rdung mtshams yod med nas bka' brgyad bstod pa'i 'bebs gdangs kyis/ hūm̐: sku ni mi 'gyur= sh+lau ka gsum mtshams yod med nas shar 'don/ hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang= bskul mtshams/ klong yangs chen po'i ngang du= 'jam rol/ bzhag rol/ rnga rol bsal/ dge bskos nas mdo bskul/ slob dpon gyis bskul/ dge bar gsungs shig karma= chos rnams= sdig pa= bsod nams 'di yis= 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal= klu rgyal= 'jig rten bde zhing= e ma hoḥ spros bral chos kyi= gdangs ma/ chab 'gyed/ 'di nas nyi ma= zangs mdog dpal gyi= gdangs ma/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i= tshe dpag med la gsol ba 'debs: tshe gzungs lan gsum/ gu ru a yu= ci tshar/ 'khor ba'i sems can gang yang rung= sogs brjod/ sgrub chen 273) gyi cha lag tu tshe sgrub zur 'tshogs dgos pa de'i tshab yin pas tshogs nam grol la mi chad pa dgos/ snang grags= kyis grol/ yar tshogs nas/ bskal pa me ltar= phur snyen brgya rtsa/ gang la nad gdon= bka' brgyad 'dzapra bskul rta dang sbyor dgos pas/ thog mar dzapra khang dbye ba ni/ bh+rum̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe maṇ+ḍal= bho dhi ru lu phaṭa dzaḥ bdag mdun= sogs nas/ sems can kun gyi sgrib pa sbyang bar gyur/ bka' brgyad zhi ba dang yang dag dzapra dbyangs sbrel mas/ bho dhi ru lu lan gsum/ sngags stong tsam bzla/ rdor sems la zhi khro mgron thabs su gtong dus gtso bo rdor sems su go 'pho ba mkhas grub chags med rin po che'i bzhed pa na raka dong sprugs lugs de 'brel chags pas de'i bzlas dmigs/

bdag mdun= ba mor nyi zer phog ltar dag par gyur/ /rdor sems yig brgya bzla/ 'di'-i skabs res mos su babs kyis tho gsos/ rgyal tho sgo byang gnyis bcas 'jug dus ltar gtang*/ lag len gong gsal ltar*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha yi zhal nas= sogs/ las sbyor gsham 'dogs nyer gcig tsam gyi bye ma la zhal phu zhu/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha tshogs= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ ḍā/ gzugs snang thams cad zhi khro'i= a āḥ cung zad mnyam par gzhag skad cig stong gsal= ngang nas spyod/ de dag ni deng 274) dus shi gson dkor zas gsol spyad zhi khro kho nas mdzad kyang snyen mtshams legs po zhig med bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon mdzad na rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba las gsungs pa'i sbom po'i bgo skal nod snyam nas 'di lta bu'i sgrub chen lan res kyang gang zag gcig pus lo bdun bsgrubs pa dang phan yon mnyam par o rgyan chen pos gsungs pa la gal 'gangs che bar bsams nas bkod pa la 'gal ba med de/ rnam rol gzugs sku'i sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams lha'i 'khor lo grangs med par 'char zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bka' mas gzhung bsrangs/ gter ma'i man ngag gis zur brgyan zhes grags pa nyid lag len du btab pa'o// de nas slob dpon mdun du lcags hom nyul+le'i ling ga can bsham/ rak+ta bran/ las phur dang thun rdzas rnams mdun du gzhag e yaṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃḥ brub khung= 'gugs pa tshar gcig ga ི mchis par= nas sil snyan 'ur/ drag sngags so snga sil snyan/ gcig gha gha= la si snyan/ gcig zhwa bcas/ thugs thig gdangs kyis/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i= mthar/ sil snyan gyis brgyud gsum la/ dang po gsum par/ rkang*/ bzhi/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ las rdor nas g.yab dar kyis tshogs pa dang dkyil 'khor bskor/ byin 'bebs nam tshar la phyag gsum/ dzapra dbyangs lan gsum/ khyab bdag dang po'i= gdangs sam/ 275) lhug 'don/ bla ma rig 'dzin= bsdu rgya/ thal sbyar gyis/

dbang gi 'jam gdangs kyis/ bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems= sogs/ lan gsum ka gdangs sam phyi ma gnyis lhug badz+ra muḥ lag gnyis bsdu rgya/ swa bhā wa= sogs nas nam mkha'i khams gang bar la dbu mdzad sogs rol mo pas rdor dril pang du len/ ar+ghaṃ=sogs la rang rgya/ shab+da= la thams cad kyis dril bsil zhi rol/ ḍā/ rgya/ dkar/ dril bsil/ sman raka gtor sngags so sor lan gsum re/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ la lag gnyis kas se gol phyir bsnol gyis spros/ shu n+ya ta= 'khor 'das chos kun= yo ga bzhi dril/ de ltar= la dril bsil/ sa mā dzaḥ dril bcas bsdu rgya/ dbang gdangs che bas/ oṃ/ phyogs bcu kun na= rdor gsor/ dril 'dzin/ (Musical notes and signs here) smon lam dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ chol rgyab sil snyan 'ur phob/ rol mo pas chol rgyag ma ran pa'i sngon du rdo rje sang 'dren gyis dril sang*/ slob dpon gyis gsol= dus nang 'dren gyis ḍā ma ru dkrol/ mched byings kyis sil snyan pad skor dus nang 'dren mdzad pa spyan 'dren spyi rgyug yin/ spyan 'dren skabs thams cad la rdo rje gsor gzhan thams cad la rdor yol sha stag yin/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dril bcas rang rgya/ dam tshig= dril sang*/ oṃ/ rdor bsdam gung mo sbreng ba spyi bor gzhag hūm̐/ mdzub mo dpral bar/ trām̐/ srin lag rna 276) ltag g.yas par/ hrīḥ mthe bong ltag par āḥ mthe'u chung rna ltag g.yon/ a bhi= trūm̐/ sogs la khu tshur gung mdzub sbreng bas cod paṇa 'phyang tshul dang*/ thal mo rtse sprad/ gsham sgra ma grags bzhin du gdab/ dbang bskur bas= sogs/ dpag med nam mkha'i= yo ga bzhi dril/ pa na pe nu la dril bcas pad skor gsum/ puṣ+pe= rang rgya pad skor se gol bcas/ shab+da la zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ mtshan ldan bde ba'i= yo ga ma hā su kha= gdangs/ dril bsil/ de'i 'gres kyis/ gtsang dme'i= sha lnga= ba ling+ta= dril bsil/ yang dril stab/ rdor gsor/ dril bsil nang 'dren/

sa gnon/ mchog sbyin/ mnyam gzhag nang skor bcas skyabs sbyin/ oṃ/ bla ma dpal ldan= yo ga la dril bsil/ bde chen ye shes= la pad skor gnyis/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi= la rdor sems rgya/ de la= thal sbyar/ sh+lau kaphyi ma gnyis des 'gres/ mgon po khyod la= lhug dril bsil/ bdag gi snying gar= lhug 'don/ yig drug stong*/ yig brgya brgya/ dbang gi 'jam gdangs kyis/ thal sbyar/ oṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'= zhi rol/ rgya/ ḍā/ dkar/ dril bsil/ le'u bdun le tshan/ chab bkye/ tshogs grol/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis= sogs nas/ ngang du gyur/ shu n+ya ta= yo ga spyi gdangs kyis/ 'khor 277) 'das chos kun= ngo bor shar/ bar dang*/ sman gdangs kyis/ dwangs ma'i hūm̐ las= dam tshig can du= spyan 'dren yo ga spyi gdangs/ mngon du gyur/ bar gong ltar/ tshogs rten= sogs nas/ thal sbyar phyag gdangs kyis/ gang gi drin gyis= yo ga bzhi dril/ bde bar gshegs so= pa na pe nu= la pad skor gsum/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ mchod gdangs kyis/ dpag med nam mkha'i= thal sbyar dang*/ sngags la gdangs dus pad gsum/ rang rgya/ se gol gnyis/ lhug dus pad dang se gol re re/ shab+da= la zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ mchod gdangs/ thal sbyar gyis/ mi dbang rin chen= sngags la pad gsum/ de'i 'gres kyis/ phyogs dus= lha yi= sna tshogs dbang po'i= was+t+ra= la na bza'/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe= la gdangs phyag rgya bcas gong ltar/ yo ga bzhi dril/ oṃ/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya= gtsang dme'i= sarba pañtsa= la dril bsil/ g.yas pas sman gdeg g.yon thig gtor bcas/ oṃ/ mchod do= sogs nas/ badz+ra a mṛ ta= bdud rtsi thigs pa khar gzhag yo ga sha lnga= sngags dril bsil/ 'di ni mchog tu= dril bsil/ dril stabs gong ltar la/ yo ga'i phyag rgya bcas/ bstod pa/ 'di ni sangs rgyas= 278) la rigs lnga spyi phyag dril bsil/ bdag nyid 'od zer gyi= yig drug stong*/ yig brgya brgya/ dpal ldan rdo rje= zhi rol/

rgya/ dkar/ ḍā/ gtso bo rdo rje= rang gi thugs ka nas= gzungs thag blang*/ yig brgya nyer gcig gzungs thag bsdu/ dung chu gtso bum du blugs la/ oṃ= lha 'od du= gung tshigs gsol/ chab 'gyed/ tshogs grol/ yo ga thal sbyar gyis/ ye shes sku mchog= thugs rje'i gdung tshob= gang zhig thog med= rnal 'byor= bdag ni= yo ga dril 'dzin/ bde bar gshegs pa= skong gdangs kyis/ bskang ngo kalpas= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ bskang ngo bdud rtsis= rol mo/ gtor ma= rol mo/ rak+ta= rol mo/ sgron me= dril sang*/ e ho= lan gsum/ gsum pa dang= zhi rol/ dag 'gyur/ skong gso'i mchod rdzas byin rlabs/ badz+ra aṛta= sogs nas/ shab+da= la zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ sman raka gtor gsum byin rlabs sngags lan gsum re/ rang gi= sogs bsdu rgya/ rdor gsor/ dril bsil/ e h+ya hi= la rdo rje nang 'dren/ dril bsil/ dzaḥ hūm̐ sogs rgya med par lag gnyis steng 'og lta bur 'dzin/ ar+ghaṃ= sogs la pad rang rgya/ se gol/ shab+da= la zhi rol/ dung*/ ḍā/ badz+ra pañtsa la thig gtor/ dril bcas gtor rgya/ se gol/ dril bu rgyun chags 279) bcad dkrol gyis/ gang gi drin gyis= rdo rje thugs kar bsnol/ dril gnyis rdung gis/ mchod sbyin gtor ma= rang gi snying= rkang dung gis sna drangs/ dung chen/ thing*/ gsum/ sil/ gsum gnyis kyis/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings= bstan pa srung phyir= sil/ rkang*/ bzhi/ dung che/ sum/ gnyis/ bzhugs gsol/ mchod pa mthar/ sum/ gcig sil/ ḍā/ bzhag rol/ ma hā= sogs nas/ sngags 'bul rnams lan gsum re/ phrin las gsol/ bstod pa mthar/ sum/ gnyis/ rkang*/ bzhi/ g.yab dar/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam= sum/ gnyis/ gso rig= sum/ gnyis/ rgya/ dpal ldan= sum/ gcig sil/ bzhag rang nyid dpal chen por= nas/ spyan 'dren mgor/ thing*/ gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis mthar/ 'jam rol/ sum/ gnyis/ bzhugs gsol/ skong ba/ 'khrugs skong mgor/ nam mdzod/ s+pha ra ṇa= thing*/ gsum/ sil/ sum/ gnyis/ phud bshal/ gsol lo/

'bul lo/ la thing*/ gcig sil/ bzhag rol re/ bstod pa/ phrin bcol bcas/ gza'/ tshe ring ma/ g.yu sgron/ dur khrod lha mo/ tsi dmar/ rgyal chen rnams dpe ci 'dzoms dang*/ khyab par rol mtsho'i nyin dang por legs ldan/ gnyis par phyag bzhi/ gsum par ma ning*/ bzhi par zhal bzhi/ lnga par sngags srung dang ngan ne gnyis/ drug par gza' dang rnam sras/ bdun par dur khrod lha mo dang rje brangs yongs rdzogs tshar na shin tu legs/

rang gi thugs= bsdu rgya/ rnga bcas/ hūm̐/ slob dpon pad+ma= shab+da= la dril bsil/ gtor sngags lhug pa lan gsum/ sman raka 'dod gsol/ bstod pa/ gzhi bdag 280) gtor ma/ shab+da= la thang*/ gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ dung chen/ dkar/ kun 'grub mdzod/ sum/ sil bzhag tshogs grol dgos na bya/ las rdor pas phyag gsum/ zhwa/ lag gnyis 'dud/ tshogs kyi g.yo byad rnams byin gyis brlab pa la thugs btad par zhu/ thing*/ gsum/ sil/ sum/ gnyis/ mtshams yod med sha stag yin/ bka' brgyad rnal 'byor ting lha rkyang pas/ dengs/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid= rgya/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: ma bcos= tshogs la spyan 'dren= sil/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: bla ma= sum/ gnyis/ rgya/ bdag cag= 'jam rol/ bzhag na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan= khyad par du sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs= da dgra= nas 'gugs rol/ (Musical notes and signs here) chos kyi dbyings= bstab/ hūm̐: chos sku= man drag rdung chung bar btang bas/ bla ma kun bzang= bstabs so bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hiḥ sil/ bzhag de'i tshe las rdor pas tshogs byin rlabs la lag g.yon gyis phud skyogs bcas slob dpon gyi nang mchod las bdud rtsi dang*/ lam bum sgros chu gtsang dang bdud rtsi bran/ slar tshogs chang bran/ tshogs dang po'i dus g.yas kyis tshogs phud dang*/ g.yon gyi bdud rtsi btegs/ bshags pa la gnyis pa dang bdud rtsi bkyag 'gugs pa'i sngar tshogs tha ma la 281) rak+ta bran pa slob dpon sar gzhag zhal stabs dus phud skyogs btegs te slob dpon gyi nang mchod nas blang*/ tshogs tha ma g.yas kyis dkyil 'khor mdun btegs/ dngos rol btang yod na/ skong ba phrin bcol rnams zhwa bcas btang zin nas/ phyag bcas las rdor gyis gsol tshogs g.yas/ thod chang phud skyogs bcas g.yon gyis bzung nas/ ho/ rnal 'byor pho mo= sogs/ drangs ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis lan gdab/ cha gsum bsham/ nyer spyod phreng tshar dang*/

mdun du bzed zhal kyang bsdog las chus bran la/ ma hā kro= swa bhā wa= sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las= mkha' lding gi rgya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang gi= bsdu rgya/ rdor gsor bzhi dril yo gas/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten= e h+ya hi= la rdo rje nang 'dren/ dril bsil/ dril sang*/ pad+ma ka ma la= rang rgya/ in+t+ra ya la pad skor dal mo gsum/ ar+ghaṃ= shab+da la dril bsil/ bzhi rdeg yang*/ in+t+ra la pad gsum/ bh+yo nam mdzod la se gol/ yo gas btang na/ dbang po rdo rje= la rdor gsor/ dril 'dzin/ lha yi rgyal po= la nang 'dren dril bsil / shar phyogs gdon gyi= la sa gnon mchog sbyin/ mnyam gzhag mchod cing bstod de= la thal mo nang bkan skyabs sbyin dril bsil kho nas gtong ba'am/ lhug dus bzhi dril/ dril sang nas/ shar phyogs rdo rje= lhug 'don/ da shā= la rdo rje bcas se gol/ 282) lha dang lha min la gdangs lhug gang ltar yang rdor gsor bzhi dril/ e h+ya hi= nang 'dren dril bsil/ pad+ma ka ma= la rang rgya/ dā+e ba= la pad gsum/ ar+ghaṃ= rang rgya/ shab+da= dril/ bzhi rdog dā+e ba= pad gsum/ bh+yo= nam mdzod/ se gol/ dril sang lhug 'don gyis/ 'byung po gang dag= ye dharmā= sdig pa= gats+tsha= la rdo rje bcas se gol/ na mo/ rje btsun=la hūm̐ mdzad rgyas mchis par gyur cig la nang 'dren dril bsil/ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dza la lcags kyu/ guṃ ka ri= la lcags kyu/ g.yas kho nas se gol/ yang lcags kyu/ se gol/ yang lcags kyu/ se gol dus dril bsil/ yang de 'dra ba la dril bsil med pas gtor sngags gdangs btang na tshig rkang re re bzhin gyi tha ma la dril bsil/ lhug dus bzhi dril/ dril sang nas ye dhar= chos sbyin/ gats+tsha= la g.yas nang bskor gyis se gol/ gang dag gdug cing= dengs shig nas zhi rol 'og gtang*/ dung*/ rgya/ dkar/ 'byung po gang dag= lhug 'don/ bdag 'jug zhi khro sdig sgrib rnam sbyong ltar ram/ dpe ma 'dzoms tshe rdor sems ltar na/

dbang gi 'jam gdangs kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa= la las rdor gyis las bum sgros tshogs pa dang dkyil 'khor bskor/ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa la= gu gul 'grim/ slob dpon gyis yungs thun brab/ zhi rol/ dung*/ dkar/ maṇ+ḍal/ sa gzhi spos chus= spyod par shog thal sbyar/ 283) dbang gi 'jam gdangs/ dpal ldan rdo rje= bde shegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// byang chub snying por= /rang nyid dpal rdo rje= zhi rol rgyud gsum la/ dung chen/ rgya/ dkar/ 'ur dang por rkang*/ bzhi/ gsum par rkang*/ bzhi/ ḍā ru 'ur/ snga ma la phyir rdeb re re tsam/ 'ur gsum pa drag 'ur/ bzhi rdeg la 'ur gsum par bcad/ las rdor gyis g.yab dar/ bzhi rdeg dang po la gcig pad skor la gcig yang bzhi rdeg dang po la gcig la bcas spyi 'gres yin pas/ 'ur bar nang nas tshogs pa dang dkyil 'khor bskor/ byin 'bebs tshar nas phyag gsum/ byang 'dren pas / ra ra= sogs dus me taug thal sbyar bar bkrab nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra= spyi bor nas gzhag maṇ+ḍal/ thal sbyar/ dbang gi 'jam gdangs kyis/ byang chub rdo rje sems= lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi= sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya/ ar+ghaṃ= sogs la pad rgya/ se gol bcas/ shab+da la zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ nam mkha' gang ba'i= dbang gdangs che ba'am rang gdangs kyis/ oṃ: stong gsal chos dbyings= la las rdor pas brag gzed bcas gtso bum g.yas pas thogs/ spos ring bcas slob dpon la bum pa phul/ gzhan rnams kyis rdor gsor/ sngags la bum pa spyi bor 'jog pa dang bum chu myang*/ bum pa dkyil 'khor la bzhugs su gsol/ 284) de ltar= gdangs che chung skabs bab kyis/ āḥ mtshan ldan= la gsang thod bdud rtsi'i steng*/ phud skyogs yu ba slob dpon la btad de phul/ sngags la bdud rtsi myang*/ gzugs dang= sogs la dril bu thal mo'i rtser bkon la zhal tshur bstan gyis gzung*/ sin+dhu ra'i me long slob dpon la phul nas lag g.yas pas gzung*/

a nu ra ga= la 'khyud rgya/ thog mtha'= la shel rdo/ sngags la mig lam g.yugs/ bzlas lung la slob dpon la sngags byang*/ gzhan gyis phreng ba gzung*/ yang snying*/ satwa bdun/ yig brgya la dril med/ dril bsil/ thal sbyar gyis dbang gi 'jam gdangs/ gtso bos= sa gzhi= tshe snyen/ le'u bdun le tshan/ chab bkye bsdu/ tshogs grol/ phur snyen dang yo ga spyi gdangs kyis/ he ru ka yi grong khyer du= sogs/ thing gsum/ sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) bka' brgyad lhag gdangs kyis/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye med= sh+lau+au ka ya zung mtshams nas lhug 'don/ phrin las mdzod/ las rdor pas phyag gsum/ zhwa bzung nas/ lhag gtor byin gyi rlob pa la thugs gtod par zhu/ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes pa'i dus lhag ma la kha phru zhu/ phud skyogs su tshogs chang thogs pa slob dpon gyi mkha' lding rgya nang nas shugs/ mañdza'i khar gzhag thams cad kyis zhwa bzhes/ lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pas 285)nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ e a ral+li pheṃ dzaḥ la 'bar ba'i rgyas g.yon du bskor/ bshugs pa lan gnyis/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe=la/ dung chen/ rkang*/ thing*/ sil/ ḍā/ rnga shar rtags yin/ zlog gdangs kyis dal mos/ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi= gnas bzang sogs la g.yab dar lan gnyis/ skom bzang la sman raka bran/ lhag gtor dus g.yas g.yon 'bran thur bcas pad skor gyis lhag snod dpal 'bar bcas btegs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho nub tu btson du 'dzin/ (Musical notes and signs here) mdzod/ sil/ ḍā/ bzhag na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud kyi= da dgra= nas/ 'gugs rol / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/ ma hā ka la shā sa na gsum/ thing gsum/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ bzhi/ sil/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas= phyi nang gsang mchod= bstan dang 'gro ba'i= gnyis dang res mos/ de'i tshe las rdor gyis gtor 'bul me sgron bcas lag g.yas kyis bzung*/ g.yon gyi 'bran thur bsnol ma'i steng gser skyems bzung*/

dgyes pa chen pos= skabs su slob dpon gyis phyag nas 'thor ba dang phyi rol gtsang sar phul/ (Musical notes and signs here) skyong bar mdzod/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ sil/ bzhag rol/ rgya gling gcad/ dung ṇir/ 286) sngags la thing gcig sil/ bzhag he ru ka ཿdpal= sogs nas/ yig brgya la slob dpon rkyang pas dril bsil/ brtan bzhugs la nas 'thor/ gats+tsha la rdo rje bcas se gol gtogs/ dge ba= rab 'byams= gdangs ma dang lhug res mos/ (Musical notes and signs here) bkra shis shog thing gsum/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ gsum/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐: bka' dang dam tshig= la gsang 'dus ma g.yel rta la bskyon te tshig bzhi/ man lhug (Musical notes and signs here) mdzod/ bka' brgyad chad tho'i dbyangs kyis/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus= tshig bzhi/ man lhug sdong grogs mdzod: (Musical notes and signs here) bka' brgyad brtan mas/ hūm̐ bh+yo: shar gyi= sogs nas tshig bzhi man lhug mdzod: sum/ gnyis/ rgyang mtshams can nang*/ nṛ tri badz+ra a ku sha dza ཿ dza hūm̐ baṃ hā+oḥ de'i tshe chad tho'i dus las rdor gyis lag g.yon gyis 'bran thur bsnol steng brtan gtor tshur bstan gyis lte thad gzung*/ lag g.yas kyis chad tho me sgron bcas btegs/ zhwa gyon bzhin pas brtan ma'i mgor phyi rol du 'khyer/ zhwa gyon bzhin gtor snod gral mdor sbub/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag mtshan zhu/ gtor snod steng rgya gram du dgaud/ zhwa phud nas gzhung gral g.yas pa'i mtha' nas g.yas bskor gyis phyag g.yas pa'i rtsar bslebs nas rdo rje phul/ gzhung gral g.yon pa bcas bskor nas gtor gzhong du 'bru 'thor la bsdu dgos/ bka' brgyad 287) bro gdangs/ hūm̐: phyogs med= tshig bzhi gdangs/ man lhug 'don/ (Musical notes and signs here) dbyangs su non/ sil/bzhag dung ṇir/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= thing gcig sil/ bzhag brjod med shes rab= ma rnyed yongs su= rnams lhug 'don dang*/ yig brgya slob dpon dril bsil bcas lan gsum/

'dir ni gzugs dang= su pra= nas 'thor/ gzugs snang thams cad= a aḥ cung zad mnyam par gzhag skad gcig stong gsal= na moḥ'akhor gsum= man rnga 'don gyis/ bkra shis gdangs ma / (Musical notes and signs here) shogaḥ thing gsum/ sil/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ rnga gzhag zhwa phud/ bsod nams 'di yis= ༈ nyin gnyis pa sogs la rdor sems tshogs btang na tshogs zhus tshar ba dang*/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ= oṃ āḥhūm̐= sogs/ lan gsum/ yo ga bzhi dril gyis/ oṃ/ bsod nams ye shes= e h+ya hi/ nang 'dren/ dril bsil/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ ḍā/ rgya mi bcad/ gu ru badz+ra satwa= pad rgya/ shab+da= zhi rol/ ru pa= rgya se gol/ shab+da= bzhi rdeg yo ga dril/ gzugs sgra= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ thog med dus nas= zhi rol/ dkar/ skong ba tshang ma gtang*/ yig brgya/ badz+ra ma hā shṝ= dkon mchog gsum la= hūm̐ mdzad rgya/ nṛ yaṃ/ lcags kyu/ tri yaṃ/ lcags kyu/ dzaḥhūm̐/ rang rgya/ slob dpon gyis phur pa gzung*/ yo 288) ga bzhi dril/ nga ni za byed= zhi rol/ dug lnga= zhi rol/ lha tshogs thams cad= satwa āḥ las rdor pas/ chos dbyings bhan+dhar= bla mas/ 'dod don= cha gsum/ bdag 'jug gdod nas lhun grub= lhag zhus/ khang phru zhu/ a ral+li= 'bar rgya/ bshugs pa gnyis/ puṣ+pe= zhi rol/ ḍā/ dkar/ yo gas/ sngon tshe zhal bzhes= zhi ro/ ḍā/ dkar la lhag ma bskyal/ gsol ka bskyang*/ zhwa gyon bzhin/ 'bru gsum/ yo gas chad tho/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ bh+yo: slob dpon= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ zhwa phud/ mchod rlabs/ shab+da= zhi rol rgya/ dkar/ ḍā/ dung*/ mchod pa/ shab+da= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ mi rtog rdo rje= yo ga rigs lnga spyi phyag rdor dril bcas thal sbyar/ ma rnyed yongs su= yig brgya lan gsum/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= su pra= nas 'thor/ rang gi snying ga'i= ngang du gyur/ gzhag oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ rdo rje spyi bor/ mgrin par/ snying khar/ rdo rje sang*/ khu tshur bsnol mas gnas gsum/ badz+ra kā bā=

rdor dril gzan zhabs zhwa rtse g.yas bstan gyis gzung*/ bla ma yi dam= gdangs lhug res mos/ ye dharmā= dus zhwa bzhes/ gnyis dril/ oṃ: byin rlabs= bkra shis shog: zhi rol/ ḍā/ rgya/ dung*/ dril gzhag bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ ༈ 289) bzang spyod/ gang du skyes pa'i= chos tshul 'di yang= gdangs bcas/ rgyal ba kun gyi= sa la 'og min= thub bstan mdzes pa'i= snga 'gyur bstan pa= bkra shis phan bde'i= bkra shis rgyal ba= bslab pa gsum ldan= phan bde'i 'byung= bde gshegs sras bcas= de ltar 'grub pa'ang dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig zhwa bcas bzhengs/ slob dpon mdun du rgyal tshab sngags chas bcas g.yab dril 'dzin pas bzhugs/ las rdor pas lcags hom nyul+le'i liṅga rgyal tshab mdun cung zad sgra dang bcas par bzhag pa dang*/ byang 'dren pas/ e yaṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ brub khung= na mo/ rig 'dzin= gdangs ma/ thams cad kyis hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya bcas/ khyad par du sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs= mchis par gyur cig 'gugs rol spyi ltar gyi/ lan gsum gyi rjes ma'i/ (Musical notes and signs here) dus ṭak+ki 'cham pa thon nas/ (Musical notes and signs here) chos kyi dbyings nas= rangs gdangs/ (Musical notes and signs here) nas pa/ shin tu mi bzad= gdangs/ mdzod dang*/ 290) hūm̐: nga ni dpal= la me mtshams gdangs/ (Musical notes and signs here) drag sngags so lnga rang gdangs/ rol mo btegs rdung*/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: rkang drag 'bud bzhi ging pa dkyil 'khor rgyab tu ldog rnga dal mo re re tsam rdeg drag sngags so lnga brjod/ rgyal tshab pas skam rlon thun rdzas brab/ phur pas tshe khrus gsal 'debs pa sogs bya/ de nas rgyal tshab pas dril brda dang sbrags/ rkang dung tshar gcig 'bud pa dang*/ ging pa thon nas/ (Musical notes and signs here) 'ur/ bdun 'cham gnyis gong ltar gyis ldog

sil/ 'bebs/ sum gnyis kyis/ shar phyogs dkar mo= rang gdangs/ sum gnyis/ tshags kyis/ spyan rtsa= rang gdangs/ sum gnyis/ (Musical notes and signs here) bu yug thog 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'khyug bzhad pa he dang dpal gyi spu gris gtams/ /drag rdung 'bring pos gtang*/ rngam pa'i= ag tshom= gnyis la bshugs pa btang*/

bskal pa'i= lag pa= tshig rkang gnyis la rkang dung gtang*/ de 'dra res mos kyis mtha' phud/ (Musical notes and signs here) dam nyams nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlogs// dam tshig dus la bab po sa ma ya: rkang bzhi/ rol mo re re tsam/ dung chen btsir dung 'bud/ las rdor gyis gu gul bdug ging pa gnyis/ rdo rje mtshams pa sngags chas pa gnyis/ khro 'bag gyon pa gzung*/ rgyal tshab bcas pas/ 291) tshogs pa'i gsib dang dkyil 'khor la bgegs bskrad/ phyi sgo'i rgyab bar phebs nas rgyal tshab kyis dril brda dang sbrags rkang dung lan gcig btang ba dang nang du log las rdor gyis g.yab dar/ rgya gling gtang*/ sil/ 'bebs/ sum gnyis/ dal mos byin 'bebs dus gsum bde gshegs lag len ltar byas nas gtang*/ dzapra dbyangs lan gsum bcas/ ༈ nyin gnyis pa sogs la/ shar phyogs dkar mo= mtshams na/ 'gugs rol (Musical notes and signs here) gsum pa'i/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas// shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa// dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ /de ni drag rol che ba yin/ nga ni dpal chen= drag rol 'bring po bu yug thog 'bebs lta bus gtang nas 'cham pa thon/ (Musical notes and signs here) thang*/ thang*/ thang*/ thang*/ 'ur*/ bir sbram/ shar phyogs dkar mo= tshig bzhi gdangs/ (Musical notes and signs here) sbar/ sbram/ bu yug thog 'bebs man 'cham gdangs/ bdud la bab na man brel/ (Musical notes and signs here) sa ma ya/ thang*/ rkang gcig thang*/ de 'dra bas bgegs bskrad rgyug 'khor= nas/ rkang gcig thang*/ (Musical notes and signs here) ma ra ya/ 292) de 'dra gsum/ 'ur bir sbram/ 'ur phob/ rgya gling*/ g.yab dar bcas byin 'bebs gtang*/ snang grags rig gsum gyis= tshogs grol/ slar tshogs nas bzlas par bzhugs/ mtshan mo thun bzhi la tshig bdun gsol 'debs/

rdor sems brgyud 'debs/ bla ma rig 'dzin= bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ gsol gdab/ mdun bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ dbang skur/ phyag mchod/ bstod pa/ bzlas dmigs/ satwa ci rigs pa dang yig brgya la thun gzung*/ nyin par snyen rgyun pas snga nyin mdun bskyed nang nas yig brgya rkyang par thun gzung*/ 'dir sleb pa dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'= gsol gdab/ bsdu ldang*/ bla ma yi dam= bkra shis bcas byas nas grol lo/ /thun phyi mas bdag bskyed bzlas pa la sleb pa dang*/ thun snga mas gsol gdab/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis/ nyin gung ltar nyul+le bskrad pa/ byin 'bebs/ 'phags mchog ma 'dzapra dbyangs lan gsum re byas te grol dgos/ nam langs thun bzhi pa grol ran pa dang*/ nyin par snyen rgyun pas tshig bdun brgyud 'debs nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa yig brgya la sleb pa dang*/ thun bzhi pas mtha' bsdu ba nyin zhag thams cad la 'gres shes par bya/ de'i 'gres kyis sgrub chen dngos gzhi nyin 293) du yod la gtong ba las spar dgab ci'ang med/ nyin mtshan dus drug la dngos grub skul tshig mkhas grub chags med rin po che'i gsung de 'byor na legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur la/ sgrub pa'i byin rlabs dbyangs kyis 'bod dgos pas bka' brgyad gsang 'dus rnams dang*/ zhi khro rang lugs su grags pa'i brag dmar lugs de rnams kyang ci 'gro btang ba dang*/ gar 'cham gras rnams kyang snang chung du ma song bar sgrub pa'i chings cha lag thams cad tshang na/ ja bskol ba'i chas thams cad tshang na ja bskol chog pa bzhin/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i cha lag phran bu yang nyams mi shor ba re gal che che/ sgrub pa song grol rgyu'i de ring la phyi thun bum bzlas kyi mjug tu sgrub khog gi dngos grub dmigs bzlas gtong dgos pas/ dal mdun gzhi dkar por g.yang drung chos skor gro yis bris pa'i khar mngar gsum zho mar 'o mas sbrus pa'i bang rim gsum steng nor bu'i dbyibs can/

shar du gdan zlum po gsum gyi steng du zhi bshos dkar po/ lhor gru bzhi gsum brtsegs la rgyas gtor ser po/ nub tu zla gam sum brtsegs dbang gtor dmar po/ byang du zur gsum sum brtsegs steng drag gtor nag po de rnams grangs ci tsam 'byor ba dang*/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du thod chang mar ril can kha dar dmar gyis bkab pa rnams bsham/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas= satwa 'i 294) gsham du/ kā ya= sbyar ba brgya/ yig brgya la btags pa nyer gcig de nas/ ye shes sku mchog= la 'jug gtor bsngos sam/ cho ga rnga chog skabs su babs na las byang bkra shis rjes su bkra shis dga' ba 'khyil pa'i rol chen bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi gzhir/ gang dag 'dir gnas= nas dkar gtor dang yig drug brgya/ yig brgya nyer gcig swa bhā wa= sogs la thal mo sa la bsnun pa gnyis/ oṃ ma hā amṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐/ chag chag g.yas bskor gcig bcas nang du phebs nas tshom bu yab yum dgod/ de nub thun gsum cung tsam brel bar gtang*/ grol nyin thun bzhi pa dang chabs gcig tshig bdun brgyud 'debs/ bsang chu/ dkar bgegs/ tshogs gsag mchod rlabs/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ gsol gdab/ nyer bsdu/ mdun bskyed/ bzlas pa/ bum snyen mjug tu dngos grub bzlas pa snga nyin ltar gtang*/ sngags rgyun pas dngos grub blang ba'i sngags rgyun/ ye shes sku mchog= gang zhig thogs med= rnal 'byor dbang po= bde bar gshegs pa= skong chen lnga/ dag 'gyur bcas/ gsol ka dril chog rdor sems tshogs byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ mchod bshags/ bsgral bstab/ mthar/ drag shing mi hom gru gsum nang zan kong bcas/ me sgron gyis me sbar ba nyul+le'i ling ga shing skam bar du btsir bar slob dpon gyis me sbar zhing*/ sngags mthar/ 295) sarba sha truṃ rū pa tsit+ta ag+ne rā dza dz+wa la raṃ khā hi khā hi/ zhi rol la btsir rdung*/ rkang bzhi/ las rdor gyis tshogs drang*/ slob dpon gyi lan gdab/

zhwa bzhes/ hūm̐/ rnal 'byor chen po'i= hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa= zhi rol/ dung*/ zhi khro'i srung 'khor/ byin 'bebs 'phags mchog ma/ zhi rol brgyud gsum/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ rkang*/ ḍā/ zhwa phud thal sbyar bcas/ ye shes sku mchog= zhwa bzhes/ yo ga bzhi dril/ hūm̐/ lha dang= hūm̐/ dngos grub= hūm̐ āḥ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung chen/ zhwa phud/ de ltar rtse gcig= lhug yig drug mthar/ kā ya sid+dhi= btags pa brgya'am stong*/ yig brgya la btags pa brgya'am nyer gcig dngos grub thams cad= skya rengs 'char kha dang bstun/ dbang chas ma gtogs sgrub rdzas thams cad dang dngos grub rdzas rnams bcas las rdor gyis slob dpon la phul/ des rgyal thebs rnams la gnang*/ de dag gis tshogs pa la 'gyed dgos pas/ zhwa bcas/ hrīḥ ye shes lus can= bstsal du gsol/ bar dang*/ gong ga ི hūm̐/ bde gshegs rgyal ba= hoḥ bar dang*/ stan thog de nyid du= dal myur spel ma'i rol ring*/ rgya gling*/ dung chen bcas dbang ma tshar bar du gtang*/ ji ltar bltams= nas bdag 'jug cha tshang tshogs pa thams cad nas blang*/ le'u bdun le tshan dang chab 'gyed/ tshogs grol/ 296) cha gsum gtang*/ sbyin sreg bya sar/ thab stegs gru bzhi par khru gang pa'i zlum skor gcig de nang sor bzhi pa'i zlum skor gnyis/ de nang rdor phreng sor gang ba'i zlum skor gcig de nang sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa kha dog kun nas dkar por byas pa la/ lci ba ser ka ma'am shing gis brtsig me yol la gangs ri/ mtsho/ baṃ bdun rnams bris pa dang*/ g.yon ngos su bdag bskyed bla gtor me gtor gnyis dang sman raka mchod pa bskor bshams ci bder sreg rdzas yam shing mtho gang ba stong phrag gcig dang bcu bzhi/ mar khu dgang blug bcas/ til/ zho zan/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro dūrba/ ku sha sreg rdzas phyogs bsdus yungs dkar rnams dang*/ slob dpon mdun du nang mchod/

rdor dril/ ḍā ru/ las bum/ nas bzed/ bsang chu/ 'o ma bcas chas gos dkar po dang ldan pas kha shar du phyogs pas 'khod/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ brgyud 'debs/ bsang chu/ byin rlabs dkar bgegs gnyis/ tshogs gsog nas/ bdag skyed bsdu rim/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ lhar ldang*/ rdo rje thugs kar gsor la/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ dril bu dkrol zhing dkur brten/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho/ rdor dril thugs kar bsnol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga ra badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma konyahaṃ/ bsngo smon ma ran bar du mi 'bral ba dgos/ swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las gnas 297) khang= las byang mchod rlabs/ shab+da la zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ sman raka gtor sngags sreg rdzas la bdud rtsi bran/ rtse gcig gi rgyas reg oṃ swa hāḥ gsum/ nas/ gsal bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bho dhi brik+ṣa ya= nas/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swa hā/ bar lan gsum re/ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ/ me sbar/ zhi rol/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rlung g.yab lan gnyis g.yab/ zhi rol/ blug gzar gyi bar du bskor ba dang bcas te blugs/ oṃ badz+ra= sogs nas swa hā/ ku sha bskor ba bcas thab ka la dgram/ zhi rol/ ma hā kro dhi= swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngangalas= bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis= yo gas/ oṃ/ tshur gshegs= rdor yol/ sngags la mthe bong lan gnyis g.yab/ zhi rol 'og ma hā kro dhi shwa ri= oṃ ag+ne ye= rdo rje nang 'dren dril bsil/ dzaḥhūm̐= rang rgya/ dgang blug gzung*/ me lha'i= ag+ne ye= bdun gyis mar khu dgang*/ de bya de bya= bdag cag dpon slob= zhi rol/ de 'dra ba lan gsum/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ= shab+da/ zhi rol/ oṃ/ gzi brjid ldan pa= la phyed pag dril bsil gsum pa cha gsum ltar/ rdzas phud lan re/ oṃ bho dhi brik+ṣa= sogs sngags bdun re/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas pa'i gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa= 298) de'i 'gres kyis ku sha

rdzas spung yin/ yungs dkar thab tu dor/ drang srong chen pos= mar khu gzar bus g.yas bskor gyis shar lhor blugs/ badz+ra ma hā kro dhi= shu n+ye ta= stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi dbus su e las nam mkha'i= sogs mdun bskyed ltar/ rin po che'i khri bkod pa phul du byung ba'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan bkra lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ dbang gdangs che bas/ oṃ/ phyogs bcu kun na= sngags mthar/ rol ring sum khug nang*/ spos sna/ rgya gling gnyis/ mchod dpon bcas kyis zhwa phrag gzed/ spos 'bogs lag g.yon du bkal nas tshom bu thogs nas/ tshogs pa la skor ba gcig thab la skor ba gcig bcas maṇ+ḍal slob dpon la phul/ rgya gling mi bcad/ rtsa sngags tshar gcig gis yab kyi phyed ka yan yig brgyas tshom bu mchod/ rol ring nang yar sgrub khang du theg mchod dpon phyir sleb nas/ thab kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs pa ni bla ma dang gnyis su med= gsal bar gyur/ tshogs rten gyi= phyag nas/ mchod pa/ sna tshogs dbang po 'i dus me dar phul/ bstod pa/ gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ bar gtang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la raṃ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ bdun gyis mar khus dgang blug dgang*/ yig brgya gcig 'bul/ zhi rol/ de 'dra ba lan gsum/ 299) oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ lan gcig mgo 'dren rdzas thams cad la dgos/ oṃ bho dhi brik+ṣa= sogs rdzas sngags bcu re/ 'dod gsol/ zhi rol/ de bzhin du mar khu/ til/ zho zan/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ dūrba/ ku sha bar bcu re dbul/ yam shing shar bcu rtags su dgaud/ yang yam shing nas/ ku sha yan lan dgu ste khyon stong phrag gcig tshang bar bsag sreg rdzas gzhan yod na yig drug bcu/ yig brgya lan re zhi rol gyis dbul/ yig brgya tshar gcig bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'-i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/

zhes yungs kar thab tu dor/ zhi rol/ yang dgang blug satwa bdun gyis dgang*/ yig brgya rol mos dbul ba de 'dra ba lan gsum/ gtsang dme'i dri rtog= sogs kyis sman thig gtor/ sha lnga bdud rtsi'i= me gtor zlum po mtheb ril can g.yas pas blugs gzar gyis mchod/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra satwa ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha= shab+da= zhi rol/ ḍā ru bcas/ mi rtog rdo rje= yo ga'am 'gro ba rgyud lnga rigs lnga spyi phyag gis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ badz+ra muḥ thabs kyi lha tshogs rnams dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs kar gshegs par gyur/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ/ blugs gzar gyi mar khu shar lho nas bskor dkyil du blugs/ slar yang 300)me lha cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ dgang blugs/ oṃ ag+ne ye= bdun gyis mar khus dgang*/ di bye di bye= 'dod gsol zhi rol bcas kyis phul ba lan gsum/ bho dhi brik+ṣa= nas/ a pra ti ha ta bar dang sngags bdun re/ 'dod gsol lan re/ zhi rol re/ oṃ ag+ne ye a ka ro= me gtor g.yon pa blugs gzar gyis mchod/ dril bu gnyis rdung gis/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di zhes la// rnal 'byor dag cag 'khor bcas la= sogs sbrel ma zhi rol bcas/ yig brgya tshar gcig ma rnyed yongs su= bdag gi don dang= sogs nas/ gshegs par gyur// a ka ro= dung zhal 'o ma dang dri bzang chu g.yas bskor byas nas nang du blugs/ byang 'dren pas zhwa bzung nas bzhengs te/ bla ma yi dam= gdangs chen dang*/ deng nas= man yo ga ye dharmā= la thams cad nas zhwa bzhes/ bkra shis gdangs sam yo gas/ byin rlabs mchog rtsol= zhi rol mchog rkyang ngam sum khug bsam lhun tshar gcig gis sgrub khang du ldog snang grags rig gsum=

gyis tshogs grol/ dbang bskur sar ser phreng gis phebs te/ rnga tshig mgor/ thing gsum/ sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) rol cha snga mas/ thing*/ 301) phyi mas thing blangs nas de'i 'gres kyis mjug tu/ sil/ bzhag rol re re bya/ lwa ba'i lding gur nang sleb nas/ tshig bdun/ brgyud 'debs/ bla ma rig 'dzin= nas bdag bskyed bstod pa yan/ phaṭa dzaḥ 'dzapra khang dbye/ bdag mdun mthar thug 'od lnga'i= yig drug stong*/ yig brgya brgya tsam/ oṃ: dpal ldan= rol mo/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃ: sogs rig me dor/ oṃ/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i: 'jug par 'tshal/ /ji ltar bltams pa= kha ṭ+wā ga bkye/ ṭak+ki 'cham stabs sogs 'tshams rngams kyis bgegs bskrad/ maṇ+ḍal/

dpal ldan rdo rje= bla ma dpal ldan= bde gshegs sras bcas= slob dpon gyis/ dpal rdo rje= sogs nas bdag 'jug cha tshang dbang gi tshul du bskur/ gtso bos ji ltar= sa gzhi spos chus= bsdu ldang*/ dge bsngo/ bkra shis bcas bya'o// ser sbreng snga mus kyis dbang bskur nas sgrub khang du ldog snang grags rig gsum= gyis tshogs grol/ slar tshogs nas/ phur snyen dang*/ gdod nas lhun grub= lhag zhus/ zhwa bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a ral+li= bshugs pa gnyis/ puṣ+pe= zhi rol/ ḍā/ dkar/ sngon tshe zhal bzhes= yo ga bzhi dril/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ ging pa gnyis kyis sngar gyi lhag ma dang lhan gcig sgrub khang gi lho nub gom pa bdun cu'i bar du bskyal/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= sogs/ 'gugs rol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐= gsum/ sha sa nā= sngags 'bul lan gsum/ bzhengs nas/ rgya/ dung rnams 302) khang thog nas 'bud/ thing gsum/ sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) gtor 'bul gdangs chen gyis tshig rkang gnyis/ de nas lhug 'don/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don= gdangs ma/ bzhag rol rjes gral du bzhugs/ mchod bstod/ bshags brtan/ gshegs gsol/ dge bsngo/ bkra shis bcas/ de'i tshe gtor 'bul rgyun bzhag rnams khag steng 'bul/ chad brtan 'don dus chad brtan rgyun bzhag mchod/ slar mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ rdul tshon la dmigs nas/ oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis= sogs nas/ hūm̐ yig rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐/ ngar 'dzin rnam dag= tsit+ta hūm̐/ thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ sku gsung thugs kyis kun la khyab/ tshe snyen de nas rgyal tho bsdu par/ zlum gtor bzhi/ dmar gtor gnyis/ phyi mchod phreng tshar bcas lag len 'jug dus ltar la/

spros pa bsdu na zhi rol byas kyang chog rgyal tho bsdu par rgyas spros mos na rol chen gyis/ zhwa bcas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ thing gsum/ sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) rang gdangs kyis/ hūm̐/ rgyal po= gtor ma bzhes/ (Musical notes and signs here) sil/ bzhag sngags 303) 'bul lan gsum/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ=la thing gcig sil/ rol mo gong bzhin gdangs bcas/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs= bzhag rol rjes/ badz+ra muḥ bkra shis tshig bzhi gcig lho/ nub/ byang rnams de ltar yin/ sgo byang la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ sogs dang*/ sngags 'bul lan gsum/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= la thing gcig sil/ rol mo gong ltar gyi gdangs mas/ hūm̐/ bgegs kyi gnyen po= bzhag rol/ badz+ra muḥ nang sgo la de ltar gyis/ gral du 'khod/ rgyal tshab dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod/ hūm̐ mdzad rgya/ mdzub g.yas g.yon bar du phur pa len dgos pas/ oṃ badz+ra kī la ya= byang 'dren pas tshar bcu bton pa dang sbrags/ nub smad 'og gi phur pa blang*/ de bzhin du byang shar/ byang*/ nub byang*/ nub/ lho nub/ lho/ shar lho/ shar/ steng bcas mas rim gyis blang*/ phur rtse 'o mas bkru zhing*/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru= lan gcig dbu zhwa bcas g.yas bskor gyis lha tshom bsdu/ slob dpon gyis byang shar nas/ a ka ro= zhi rol 'og rdo rjes re kha 'then/ tshe snyen gyis tshogs grol/ slar tshogs nas phur bsnyen/ 'dus pa bzhengs ste/ g.yon phyogs rnams bzhengs/ g.yas phyogs pas phyag gsum/ yo gas/ hoḥ thams cad rdo rje mched dang lcam dral= tshar gcig g.yas phyogs pa bzhengs/ g.yon phyogs pas phyag gcig thams cad rdo rje mched dang lcam= tshar gcig thams cad kyis bla ma la phyag gsum/ yo ga'i rta la bskyon te/ ho/ rdo rje slob dpon= 304) gral du 'khod/ yo gas/ kye ho/ mi gnas ye shes= spyod par shog rgyal tshab pas mar me smon lam gtong thun gsung*/ dbyangs bor len gyis/ hūm̐/ bla med gsang ba= tshig mtha' lan gsum/ zhwa bor/
